# Method GetDocuments

#### GetDocuments()

Gets all the documents loaded into memory.

##### Declaration

```
[OperationContract]
[AvailableSinceVersion(7, 6, 0, 0)]
List<DocumentId> GetDocuments()
```

##### Returns

|  Type |  Description |  
| --- | --- | 
   
|  List<DocumentId> |  Documents found.  |  

##### Remarks

This method is available since v7.6.
